This agenda requires background knowledge on `r params$year` water temperature data from Shasta Dam to Wilkins Slough.

## Background

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"

# Display "wtemp" (Water Temperature F, Daily Average),
# "wtemp7dadm" (Water Temperature F, 7DADM),
# "flow" (Flow TCFS, Daily Average), or
# "turbidity" (Turbidity NTU, Daily Average)
param <- "wtemp"
# Group colors by "data" (Value),
# "targets" (Temperature Targets 56, 57, 58F), or
# "targets2017" (Temperature Targets 53, 55, 56F)
grouping_type <- "data"

img_url <- paste0(
  "https://cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/data/php/rpt/basin_cond.php",
  "?sc=1",
  "&outputFormat=graph",
  "&basin=sacramento",
  "&year=", params$year,
  "&wparam=", param,
  "&gtype=", grouping_type,
  "&resolution=medium"
)
knitr::include_graphics(img_url)
```
